facts.F1: Story #6376 S06 Connector capability interfaces, nwdes feature A of two (ratchet and rename). Make KPI 7 a test: no connector type creates a NotSupportedException apart from an inline list, read from the compiled IL so throws in private helpers and async bodies count, with made-up connectors as falsifiers. Rename the connector port's GetFeaturesForProject to GetFeaturesForPortfolio and its project parameters to portfolio, as a pure rename commit. Behaviour-free: routes, DTOs, responses, sync paths and refresh results stay the same. Design: docs/feature/story-6376-s06-connector-capability-interfaces/feature-delta.md (slices A1-A2, Ratchet design, D-6, D-7).
facts.F10: Paradigm object_oriented (CLAUDE.md). No domain decision moves, so no new domain owner, value object or aggregate is introduced; the rule core is a test-side static rule class like IlDependencies and ModuleRules.
